feature: Basic company currency labels with fixed existing amount representation

basis.referenceBehavior: A fictional empty company's manually entered symbol £ and formal name GBP persisted after save/reopen. UK/England, its initial financial/book dates and zero vouchers remained. Earlier country selection retained rupee/INR/mobile+91 and requested manual review.
basis.softwareConvention: Bookr retains integer-paise storage/API values,100 units per displayed whole amount, exactly two decimal places and en-IN numeric grouping. These are existing original Bookr conventions, not recovered universal currency or GBP rules.
basis.limits: No reference precision, conversion, exchange rate, locale, denomination, country-prefix or posted-company currency alteration behavior is established. This is not a complete foreign-currency feature.

fields.validation: Original software limits: reject raw control characters U+0000..001F and007F before trimming outer whitespace; require nonempty single-line text and reject values beyond the stated limits. Preserve case/Unicode; do not infer an ISO code or locale. These bounds are not claimed native limits.
fields.patch: An omitted field preserves the target's existing effective value; new/legacy profiles default missing pairs to ₹/INR. Incoming edits may change either field independently. A raw stored profile with only one field, invalid type or noncanonical label must fail closed rather than mix an unknown setting with INR.
fields.unknownSettings: Recognize only these two additional flat metadata fields. Preserve existing reserved raw-id/revision rejection and unknown setting write/export rejection. Precision/rate/conversion fields remain unsupported.

mutation.target: Use fresh target profile and revision in URL-bound PUT independently of the active API company header. Retain ordinary409 conflict handling and exact catalog/accounting preservation on failure.
mutation.emptyScope: Only an actual normalized symbol/name change requires empty financial books. Reuse the Calendar feature's central empty-financial-book guard after its publication/rebase; do not duplicate table/schema checks. Do not derive emptiness from active browser state or voucher count alone. Protect its check/publication against concurrent writes using the shared guard's locking contract.
mutation.unchangedLabels: Ordinary name/contact/country edits may echo unchanged normalized labels on posted companies and remain supported. No currency change means no new empty-book restriction.
mutation.preservation: No conversion or reinterpretation of saved amounts; no voucher/ledger/bill/allocation/sequences/revision changes beyond the one company-profile revision on an accepted edit. Country, mobile prefix and dates never automatically rewrite labels, and label edits never rewrite those fields.
mutation.session: Inactive targetC owns form/calendar/currency. ActiveB, its rails, loaded IDs, working date and period remain unchanged. Save/cancel return to target selector without selecting/reloadingC.
mutation.publishedRecovery: The canonical returned labels bind with the saved UUID/revision before follow-up GET/open requests. Published fields stay disabled on refresh failure; retry reads/opening only, never duplicatePUT/POST.

display.descriptor: Explicit immutable per-company/profile descriptor, never a mutable module-level current currency. companyCurrency(profile) returns the two flat canonical label fields; legacy missing pair defaults, malformed partial pair rejects.
display.numericHelpers: parseRupees/inputRupees/formatRupees/formatBalance retain numeric behavior and remain stateless. Replace the parser's hardcoded rupee limit text with a neutral amount-limit message. A pure formatCompanyAmount(amount,profile) can prefix the explicit symbol for existing labelled messages.
display.binding: Keep company-base-currency-symbol/company-currency-formal-name IDs compatible. Replace strong text nodes with explicit inputs only in supported UI; preserve canonical saved binding, readonly/disabled state, formatted date controls and dirty tracking. Use value/textContent or existing escaping, never unescaped configured text in HTML.
display.navigation: Enter from symbol advances to formal name, then existing acceptance confirmation; existing Tab/ShiftTab, Ctrl+A and safe Escape/discard conventions apply. Do not introduce extra precision controls.
display.labels: Replace fixed symbol/name literals in company form, rails, bill captions, financial/monthly captions and saved-voucher notices using their explicit book/profile context. Accessible amount labels that currently say in rupees must become neutral or use the explicit profile name. Retain current numeric grouping/DrCr signs. Initial/no-company rails stay neutral until a company profile is known.
display.oldServer: Global capability company_currency_labels enables editing. Without it, keep currency controls readonly/default-safe and make no unsupported field writes. Currency-labelled unsupported responses must not silently render as INR.
display.oldClient: Original web compatibility protocol approved for this limited feature: require X-Bookr-Currency-Labels:1 for nondefault scoped reads/writes. Missing awareness rejects400, without financial writes. Default legacyINR clients remain compatible. This is neither authentication nor a reference-app behavior. GET refresh needs awareness only; an old numeric draft context does not prevent retrieving fresh labels. Revision-bound company metadata PUT evaluates the URL target independently of the active-company header and does not use monetary draft context.
display.stateBinding: Validate the requested active company profile against its accounting-state labels before publishing a Book or changing selection/context storage. Supported servers must return both explicit matching labels, even for defaultINR. Known nondefault labels require both current global and state currency support; legacy wholly missing/defaultINR remains compatible. Inspect only the requested active profile, never infer labels from inactive loaded companies. Missing/partial/disagreeing declarations show an original update/refresh error and never fall back to another company or label.

numericDraftProtocol.header: New clients send X-Bookr-Currency-Context with encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({currency_symbol,currency_name})) on numeric voucher/opening writes. JSON contains exactly the two canonical saved labels; URI encoding keeps the header ASCII because raw rupee text is not a valid HTTP ByteString. This protocol describes labels only and is not authentication.
numericDraftProtocol.scope: All voucher POST/PUT requests, and master POST/PUT requests explicitly containing opening_balance or opening_bills, use the originating numeric draft context. Metadata-only company PUT is governed by its target revision instead. Portable restore is governed by its version/checksum/profile validation rather than an active monetary draft header.
numericDraftProtocol.legacy: An absent context remains supported only when fresh current labels are the exact default rupee/INR pair. When a context is supplied it must match both fresh labels even for default companies. Nondefault numeric writes require awareness plus a matching context. Missing/stale/malformed context rejects409 without catalog or accounting changes; missing nondefault awareness rejects400.
numericDraftProtocol.race: Read and validate the complete body first, then re-read authoritative target labels and recheck awareness/context immediately before the monetary mutation. A Book obtained before await body is not proof of current labels. Retain the shared Calendar/currency locking contract against concurrent profile/financial writes, with no asynchronous gap between the final checks and the synchronous mutation.
numericDraftProtocol.draft: Capture label context when a numeric entry draft opens; retain it across a rejected save and do not replace it silently from a background refresh. On a409 currency-context error, keep the editable unsaved numeric values and require leaving/reopening against the fresh profile before another interpretation is possible. No automatic resubmission or amount conversion.
numericDraftProtocol.prospectiveProof: Delayed owned HTTP bodies cover legacy voucher awareness, aware stale voucher context and aware stale ledger-opening context; an independent second request changes only an empty target's labels while the first body is incomplete. A two-tab browser draft must reject the stale first-tab voucher twice without posting, while an aware GET can still refresh the new labels.
numericDraftProtocol.awarenessValidation: Only a genuinely absent X-Bookr-Currency-Labels header is legacy. Any present value other than exact1, including0,2 or an empty value, rejects400 on scoped reads/writes even for defaultINR. Global capabilities and company discovery remain available for recovery. Numeric legacy fallback requires absence plus the fresh exact default pair.

denominations.supported: Existing fixed Indian banknotes remain available only for the exact default ₹/INR label pair. A pure supportsCompanyDenominations(profile) controls the UI and server restriction.
denominations.nondefault: Do not display fixed Indian notes under £/GBP or invent foreign notes. Disable/hide the denominations action with an original explanatory limitation; reject an explicitly supplied denominations payload for a nondefault company before posting. Preserve all stored existing denomination rows and numeric values.
denominations.capability: company_currency_labels describes this limited engineering feature; it does not claim general currency/foreign-cash support.

portable.writer: Export explicit portable VERSION2 with both label fields, the existing exact accounting tables/sequences, canonical SHA256 checksum and no conversion.
portable.legacyReader: Keep strict VERSION1 company-field validation. Verify the original V1 checksum before inserting legacy ₹/INR defaults into an internal copy. Never add fields to/mutate the source bundle before verification. V1 bundles containing currency fields still reject as unknown.
portable.v2Reader: Require exact knownV2 fields including both labels; reject partial/unknown fields, unsupported versions and malformed/corrupt checksums atomically. Preserve exact records and labels on restore-as-new UUID without editing source books.
portable.financialMeaning: Backup/restore preserves original Bookr integer records and declared labels; it does not infer or perform exchange conversion. Drafts cover configured-empty£/GBP and posted-defaultINR round trips, not native foreign transaction parity.
portable.ui: Update file preflight to accept only advertised V1/V2 support and retain published restore OpenCompany retry. Existing old-serverV1 restore stays usable; V2 against an old server is rejected beforePOST. New capability company_backup_v2 advertises the versioned format.

accountingEffect: None from label configuration. All existing amounts remain integer paise and unchanged; an unrelated posted INR company retains100000sale/40000receipt/60000outstanding.
